Hi Grace,

Thanks again for getting the paperwork over the finish line — thrilled to be moving forward. Before we spin up our onboarding calendar, can you send a concise mutual action plan that embeds the post-signature rollout, canary plan, migration windows, and the evaluation sprint you mentioned on the call? - Include a short list of training sessions with target audiences (Dev, Platform, CS).

Alex — attaching the MAP draft and a short evaluation-sprint plan. High-level notes below; full details are in the attached MAP_CascadeWorks_v1.2.xlsx and evaluation-sprint-plan.pdf.

Summary (one-paragraph):
We propose a three-week post-signature program: week 0 (kickoff & environment prep), week 1 (canary deployment + smoke eval), week 2 (migration + training + final acceptance). The canary runs for three nights within week 1 (11 PM–3 AM ET) with rollback gates and a staging mirror of 48-hour traffic. Training is delivered as two 60-minute workshops (Dev integration; Platform ops) and a 30-minute stakeholder walkthrough (CS & Exec).

Proposed immediate timeline:
- 2027-04-19: Executive kickoff (30m) — confirm final cutover window and SSO/KMS scopes.
- 2027-04-21 - 2027-04-23: Canary nights (three non-consecutive nights; default 23:00–03:00 ET).
- 2027-04-25: Migration dry-run during maintenance window (midnight local).
- 2027-04-27: Production cutover + acceptance test suite run.

Attachments: MAP_CascadeWorks_v1.2.xlsx (mutual action plan with ownership and gates), evaluation-sprint-plan.pdf (acceptance criteria, sample prompts, metrics), migration-checklist.csv (ops checklist).

Quick asks for CascadeWorks before our kickoff:
1) Confirm a primary contact for SSO/KMS tests (name + availability).
2) Share any blackout dates for April 21–27.

I'll loop Marissa to own the sprint coordination and Jonas to own migration ops. Happy to jump on a quick sync if you prefer to walk the MAP live.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Rollback policy: automated fallback to the prior model variant and a customer-visible degraded-mode banner for 5 minutes while ops triage.
- Escalation path: Jonas (migration lead) -> Marissa (eng ops) -> Grace (solution lead) -> Redwood on-call.
- Training plan: two hands-on sessions (Dev/Platform) scheduled during business hours in week 2; recorded sessions and step-by-step runbook will be posted to the shared drive.

Action items for CascadeWorks (owner / due):
- Confirm KMS/SSO test account and IAM role by 2027-04-19 (Samantha).
- Approve the canary night windows or propose alternates by 2027-04-20 (Alex).
- Share a short list of high-risk prompts for the evaluation sprint by 2027-04-21 (Alex engineering).

I'll prepare the calendar invites once the canary nights are locked. If anyone needs to shift the migration dry-run date, flag now — ops teams will need 48 hours for runway.

-Marissa
